snippet.title: Noctuary - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Noctuary, the narrative-driven action RPG, fuses thrilling combat and challenging boss fights into a gorgeous visual novel adventure ✨ Coming to Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and PlayStation 5 on July 30th!

Wishlist the game on your platform of choice today: 
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/noctuary-switch/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012287
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9ntgknvt75n0
